notes.content: An advertisement for the Fashion Publicity Company clipped from The Ladies' Home Journal for September, 1919. The advertisement features a color illustration of a caricatured Pullman porter figure bringing shoes to a woman in a green train car. The porter is depicted in a grey uniform with dark pants. At bottom left is text with information on the Fashion Publicity Company and an imagined conversation between the woman and the porter about her "F.B. & C." shoes. On the reverse is a full-page color advertisement for Sunkist oranges.

notes.content: Objects depicting racist and/or stereotypical imagery or language may be offensive and disturbing, but the NMAAHC aims to include them in the Collection to present and preserve the historical context in which they were created and used. Objects of this type provide an important historical record from which to study and evaluate racism.
